_comment: The getting-started chain for each player's first days (PLAN.md M4 step 6). Each step is done by doing it once, in any order; its reward goes to the player's first village. The `story` is the elder's reason for asking.

steps.title: Raise a building
steps.hint: Open your village and queue any building or field upgrade.
steps.story: The elder looks at the thin palisade and the half-empty fields. "Walls and bread first, child. Everything else grows from them."

steps.title: Train defenders
steps.hint: Build a Barracks and train any unit there.
steps.story: "The hordes do not wait for the harvest. Put spears in the hands of those who can hold them."

steps.title: Claim an outpost
steps.hint: Tap a forest, hill, field or mine hex near your village and claim it.
steps.story: "The land around us is rich, and nobody tends it. Set a camp there before the beasts do."

steps.title: Send scouts
steps.hint: Build a Scout Lodge and send scouts at a horde, a camp or an ancient site.
steps.story: "Fear is what you feel about a thing you have not seen. Go and see it."

steps.title: Clear your first camp
steps.hint: Send an army to storm a monster camp or a lair (order: storm it).
steps.story: "A camp of beasts in the woods is a wave that has not yet happened. Burn it out."

steps.title: Gift a teammate
steps.hint: Send a caravan to a teammate's village or to the Holy City vault.
steps.story: "No village stands alone. What you share now comes back to you on the night the walls shake."
